content: Booking/reservation systems prevent double-booking via: (1) idempotency keys on the confirm/create-booking request so retries produce the same result; (2) a unique DB constraint on (resource_id, time_range) or reservation_id as the atomicity backstop; (3) short-lived holds with TTL (commonly Redis SETNX + expiry, e.g. 5 min) that auto-revert to available; (4) status-field state machines (available -> held -> booked) driven by atomic compare-and-swap writes, not read-then-write.
